faqs.q: What are Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound used for?
faqs.a: Soft annealed copper tube in pancake and level-wound coils to ASTM B280 and EN 12735-1, for air-conditioning and refrigeration installation and coil manufacture. It is listed in 12 sizes, 3.18–41.28 mm outside diameter.

faqs.q: How do I read an Indus part number for Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound, such as IH-TF-CC-COI-0032-076?
faqs.a: Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound part numbers begin with IH-TF-CC-COI and then give the outside diameter in tenths of a millimetre and the wall thickness in hundredths of a millimetre. IH-TF-CC-COI-0032-076 is 3.18 mm outside diameter by 0.76 mm wall, and IH-TF-CC-COI-0413-152 is the largest size listed. Quote the full part number, or the standard, grade, OD and wall.

faqs.q: What sizes do Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound come in?
faqs.a: Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound are listed in 12 sizes, 3.18–41.28 mm outside diameter, each with its own Indus part number, for example IH-TF-CC-COI-0032-076 and IH-TF-CC-COI-0413-152. The table includes 3.18 mm OD by 0.76 mm wall and 41.28 mm OD by 1.52 mm wall.

faqs.q: What do I need to send to order Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound to the right size and grade?
faqs.a: For Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound, quote the Indus part number from the size table, or send the standard and grade, the outside diameter and wall (BWG or millimetres, minimum or average wall), the length and the quantity. We quote with the mill certificates and the inspection you need.

faqs.q: What tests and certificates come with Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound?
faqs.a: For Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound, testing follows the governing standard: Eddy current. Mill test certificate to EN 10204 3.1 on request; third-party inspection by arrangement. Say on the enquiry which tests and inspection your project needs.

faqs.q: Which materials and grades are Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound available in?
faqs.a: Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound are available in these grades: C12200 / CW024A Cu-DHP. If your site needs a particular material grade, coating or material certificate, say so on the enquiry and we confirm it before the order.

faqs.q: Which standards apply to Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound?
faqs.a: Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound are made to ASTM B280, ASTM B743, EN 12735-1, EN 12735-2. Tell us the standard and grade on your enquiry; equivalent grades in other standards are indicative and are checked against each tender.

faqs.q: What do Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound connect to or fit with?
faqs.a: For Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound, tubes are rolled or welded into tube sheets or headers and carried on baffles or supports, so the outside diameter and wall must match the tube sheet drilling. Related ranges are the [Copper Tubes](/c/copper-tubes) and [Brass Tubes](/c/brass-condenser-tubes) shelves.

faqs.q: How should Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound be inspected on receipt and stored?
faqs.a: Check Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound on receipt against the order: outside diameter, wall, length, marking and the certificate heat numbers, and keep the ends capped until installation. Handle and store the material so the surface is not scratched or dented.

faqs.q: Where are Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound used?
faqs.a: Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound are used for: Split and VRF air-conditioning installation (pancake), coil and heat-exchanger production lines (LWC).

faqs.q: How are Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound shipped, and can they be exported from Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes. We ship Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, to buyers in the GCC, Africa, Asia and beyond, with export documents prepared for the destination. Give us the part numbers, quantities and delivery country through our contact page and we quote the freight and lead time with the price.

faqs.q: Do you keep Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, Copper Coils, Pancake and Level-Wound are held in stock at our Dubai, UAE warehouse and we ship worldwide with the best lead times. For a quotation, send the sizes and quantities you need through [our contact page](/contact).
